title: White sleeping bag // striped towel recipe fix
description: PolyDecorations & Tom's Server Additions recipe conflict override fix.
body:
this fixes the conflict between the white sleeping bag  (from PolyDecorations) and striped towel (from Tom's Server Additions) polymer mods.

Since Polymorph isn't updated for 1.21.11 i've decided to make this.


drop the datapack into your world's datapack folder 
`world/datapacks/<here>`

e.x;
`.minecraft/saves/myworld/datapacks/<here>` ,

another e.x;
`PrismLauncher/instances/Adrenaline/.minecraft/saves/Notchland PC/datapacks/<here>`

you might need cheats enabled (though I doubt it, but, again, im not sure; sorry. Have fun!)
